'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Warren Maruschak LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Warren Maruschak]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

No deck title. Sheet Moutix → [[Houjix]]; Working (V) → [[Wokling (V)]]. K'lor'slug (V) as written.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Warren Maruschak]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|We Have A Plan]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
